blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: In the page's call `exampleMethod(5)`, what does the page call the `5`?

options.text: A parameter: the variable named in the declaration
options.says: The page calls the variable in the declaration the parameter; 5 is what the call passes.

options.text: A return value: the value the method sends back
options.says: The page's exampleMethod is void; 5 is passed in, not sent back.

options.text: An argument: the concrete value the method is given
options.says: The page's comment says 5 is the argument: the actual value passed when the method is called.

questions.stem: Per this page, how many varargs parameters may one method declare, and where?

options.text: One at most, and it must be the first parameter
options.says: The page says the vararg parameter must be the last parameter.

options.text: One at most, and it must be the last parameter
options.says: The page says only one vararg is allowed per method, and it must be the last parameter.

options.text: Any number, as long as each follows the others
options.says: The page says only one vararg parameter is allowed per method.

concepts: Parameters are the variables a declaration names; arguments are the values a call passes.
Only one varargs parameter is allowed, and it comes last.
